name: Bukharan People's Soviet Republic
native: Бухарская Народная Советская Республика (Bukharskaya Narodnaya Sovetskaya Respublika)

predecessors.name: Emirate of Bukhara
predecessors.text: the whole emirate: West Bukhara with Bukhara and Karshi, East Bukhara from Hisor to the West Pamir

successors.name: Soviet Union
successors.text: West Bukhara, to the Uzbek SSR

successors.name: Soviet Union
successors.text: the south bank of the Amu Darya with Chardjui, to the Turkmen SSR

successors.name: Soviet Union
successors.text: East Bukhara, to the Tajik ASSR

ledger.x: 1920: the Bukharan People's Soviet Republic is proclaimed.
1924: the republic becomes the Bukharan Socialist Soviet Republic.
1924: Bukhara 'voted itself out of existence' and is divided.

wars.name: Basmachi revolt
wars.outcome: The overthrow of the emir 'sparked the Basmachi Revolt', which 'took the Red Army until 1934 to fully suppress'; no border change while the republic lasted.

certainty.note: A revolutionary republic inside the Turkestan ASSR, drawn on the emirate's old lines; East Bukhara was never fully held.

sources.title: National delimitation in the Soviet Union
